objective: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.

description: One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, <name>. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.
To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
progress: Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, <name>. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.
The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
completion: Well done, <name>. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.
Your people should be proud to count you among them.
